_comment: Vapi assistant config template. model.provider is 'custom-llm' so Vapi calls YOUR backend at model.url + '/chat/completions'. Set model.url to your Railway base URL (no path). Set server.url (below) to the same base + '/webhook' for tool execution + event logging.
name: CareCloud Voice Agent
firstMessage: Hello! Thank you for calling. How can I help you today?
_llm_note: Using Vapi's BUILT-IN OpenAI (billed from Vapi credits, no OpenAI account needed). OPTIONAL UPGRADE: to run the LLM through your own backend, change provider to 'custom-llm' and add "url": "https://<railway-domain>" — then you must set OPENAI_API_KEY in Railway.

messages.content: You are a professional, friendly voice assistant for CareCloud. Keep replies short and natural for speech. Confirm details before taking any action. ===== TASK-SPECIFIC: paste the real scenario, rules, and persona here at 9 PM =====

function.name: book_appointment
function.description: EXAMPLE. Book an appointment for a patient.
